name: Fixes
author: byo-pop
description: Fixes for the original game: each setting is one fix, on by default. They mend what the original gets wrong or makes the player wait for and leave the rest as it was. Turn a fix off, or the whole mod, for the game as it ran in 2002.

settings.label: Steady level clock
settings.help: The original times the start of a level (the animals are let in 400 ms after it) and the time on the level-up panel by the machine's clock, so two games of the same seed part by a frame or two and a game that is paused counts the pause. This counts in the game's own updates instead: the same seed and the same clicks play the same game every time.

settings.label: Water level after an early click
settings.help: When the first click ends a level's get-ready, the original leaves the water a pixel off its level for the rest of the level (the get-ready's own end brings it to its level). This puts it right.

settings.label: Quick game-over screen
settings.help: The game-over screen fades in for two and a half seconds, and asks for your name after one and three quarters of them. With this it takes a third of the time.
